summary: The document describes the Applicant's proposed erosion and sediment control measures, including concentrating construction within the Bad Creek drainage basin, seeding disturbed slopes, using sediment traps, and constructing a flow augmentation system capable of delivering up to 15 cfs to restore Howard Creek base flows, which partially addresses the recommendation for storm flow augmentation.
text: The Applicant proposes to concentrate construction activities within the Bad Creek and West Bad Creek drainage basin to minimize adverse impacts on Howard Creek. Applicant estimates that nearly all the earth and rock fill material for construction of the dams could be obtained from within the reservoir basin area, thus eliminating the use of extensive areas west of South Carolina Route 171.
